svg.text: hub, a 60 mm wide arm 267.5 mm to the stand-off holes,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and a fan from 125 to 175 mm radius.

svg.text: round 75 degrees toward the fan's far edge.

svg.text: on the outer face so the M8 heads sit flush.
